mentions.name: Solo AI RPG (Claude as DM)
mentions.description: A solo AI RPG in which Claude acts as the dungeon master, built from a world bible compiled from the D&D group's sessions 20 years ago. The basic game runs as an Artifact in Claude and aims to capture the feel of those sessions and the players' absurdities as young 20-somethings, to share with gaming buddies.
